conviction_note: The findings sum to +1.0 and the scaled number is -0.56. Both are small and they point in opposite directions, on purpose. The quarter's facts lean mildly positive: Jubilee ran above 94k bopd from mid-July, Brent spiked late in the quarter, 2027 notes were being redeemed and the RBL refinancing is due in Q4. But KOS fell after all five prints in the baseline (median -4.6%), including a sold EPS beat in Q2 (-5.95%), and the sell side turned (Jefferies to Hold on 28 Oct, MarketBeat consensus 'Reduce') after a ~200% YTD run. So the reaction function holds p_up at 46. abs_move is set at 7.0, above the 4.6% median: the 17% option-implied move is indicative only (ATM spread 40% of mid), and options overstated this move on the last two prints.
bar: Company Q3 2026 guide from the 2026-08-03 release: production 68,000-72,000 boepd, 2.75 net Ghana cargoes, 8 gross GTA cargoes, Gulf of America 13,000-15,000 boe/d, capex $75-100M, net interest $55-60M (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/kosmos-energy-di---kos/second-quarter-results-/9699682). Street: EPS $0.09 / revenue $399.7M (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/KOS/estimates) and EPS $0.08 / revenue $402.8M (https://tradersunion.com/stocks/earnings/kos-usd/). Two sources roughly agree. Barchart says there is no consensus, so the street bar is soft. Chartmill says the revenue estimate was cut 7.9% over three months. Sized against revenue of about $400M and production at the 70k midpoint.
positioning_check: Short interest 34.2M shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 2.93 days to cover on 11.7M ADV, up from 33.9M on 2026-09-30, 28.4M on 2026-09-15 and 26.7M (about 4.5% of float, 1.9 DTC) on 2026-08-21 (https://www.optionsanalysissuite.com/stocks/kos/short-interest; aggregator snippets). Shorts are building but the name is not crowded at under 3 days to cover. The baseline 25d skew is null, so the market makes no directional statement. Put/call OI is 0.51 (call-heavy). The event-implied move is 17.0%, but the ATM spread is 40% of mid, so it is indicative only. Before the last two prints options implied 14.8% and 17.4%, and the stock realised -4.59% and -5.95%. Reaction history: 0 of 5 prints up, median |move| 4.59%, max 5.95%. Sell side turned bearish into the print: Jefferies cut to Hold on 2026-10-28 (Seeking Alpha headline via https://www.rava.com/noticias?ticker=KOS_US), and MarketBeat consensus was 'Reduce' on 2026-10-23 (same list). Earlier in 2026 Goldman went to Sell ($2.25) and Mizuho to Underperform (2026-05-27). Run-up: +11.0% over 20 days, -3.0% over 5 days, 14.8% below the 52-week high, about +200% YTD.

findings.finding: Jubilee gross output was 'currently above 94,000 bopd' on 2026-07-14, against a Q2 average of about 72,000 bopd. Tullow (operator, 28 Sep 2026) says the campaign is complete, with six producers plus a water injector onstream in September, and that it expects FY production at the high end of guidance. At Kosmos's 38.6% Jubilee working interest, a Q3 Jubilee average near 88-94k bopd puts Kosmos group output at about 71-73k boepd, the top of or just above its 68-72k Q3 guide (midpoint 70k).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: production +12% y/y and an EPS beat ($0.11 vs $0.09); the stock fell 5.95% on the day (baseline). No KOS print in the last five has been bought.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The 94k figure predates the 2026-08-03 Q3 guide, so management's 68-72k guide already knew about it, and Tullow's 'high end' call has been public since August. The unpriced part is the gap between a 94k run-rate and a guide midpoint that implies roughly 85-88k. If the market had priced a top-of-guide quarter, the consensus revenue estimate would not have been cut 7.9% over three months (chartmill).
findings.independence: Tullow 2026 half-year results, 28 Sep 2026 (https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H22_AN202609281829959978_1.pdf): drilling campaign complete, FY production at the high end. The Kosmos Q2 release (2026-08-03) expected >90k bopd after J50. Partial overlap with the Tullow cargo/receivables finding, which uses the same Tullow document.

findings.finding: Brent rose through Q3: futures were $72 on July 1, peaked at $109 on Sept 15 with spot as high as $132, and averaged about $104 in the final two weeks (EIA, 2026-10-05). December Brent topped $106 again on 2026-10-12. Kosmos sells Ghana cargoes at Dated Brent at lifting, so any late-quarter liftings realise well above the quarterly futures average. October's strip also supports Q4 free cash flow toward the ~20% debt-reduction target. This is set against a consensus revenue estimate (~$400M) that was cut over the quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 realised $108.57/bbl oil and revenue of $607M, yet the stock fell 5.95% (baseline). Realised-price beats have not been paid on the print day.
findings.why_not_priced: The oil path is public. The unpriced part is cargo timing: if any of the 2.75 net Ghana cargoes lifted in the September spike, realised oil could beat a ~$90 quarterly-average assumption, and a revenue consensus cut 7.9% does not look like it assumes that. This is a macro-to-company proxy, and hedges cap it: 3.25 MMbbl for H2 2026 at an average ~$66 floor, with collar ceilings at $75.51 and swaps at $70.62 Brent and $64.83 WTI.
findings.independence: TASS 2026-10-12, December Brent above $106 (https://tass.com/economy/2171043). Hedge book from the Q2 release (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/kosmos-energy-di---kos/second-quarter-results-/9699682). This is a proxy; the company has not confirmed Q3 realisations.

findings.finding: Brent rose from about $72 (July 1) to about $104 at quarter end, so Kosmos's remaining 2026 hedges (part of 3.25 MMbbl at a ~$66 floor, ceilings around $70-75) and its 2027 hedges (2 MMbbl; extra collars at $67 floor / $84 ceiling) take a large non-cash mark-to-market loss at Sept 30. A GAAP net loss headline is likely even if adjusted EPS meets consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 printed a GAAP net loss of $124M against an adjusted loss of $72M, and the stock fell 5.73% (baseline). GAAP noise has coincided with down days, but the cause is not separable.
findings.why_not_priced: Analysts model adjusted EPS, which excludes unrealised derivatives, so the headline loss is an item for headline algos rather than for the multiple. It is a below-the-line remeasurement with no path to guidance, so it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: Brent path from EIA 2026-10-05 (https://www.eia.gov/todayinenergy/detail.php?id=68245). The hedge volumes come from the same Kosmos Q2 release the oil-price finding uses, so the two share a document but land on opposite lines (cash realisation vs unrealised MTM).

findings.finding: Kosmos redeemed $25M of its 7.75% 2027 notes on 2026-09-18 and another $25M on 2026-09-30 (8-Ks of 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-21), and said it may make further optional redemptions. It also targets completing the RBL refinancing (borrowing base ~$1.2B) by Q4 and a ~20% net-debt cut in 2026 (from $2.98B; $2.56B at June 30). A completed or near-completed RBL refinancing announced with the print would remove the main 2027 maturity overhang.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Jan 2026 Nordic bond and 2027-note tender: not in the baseline's print reactions. A third-party review of Q2 notes that the company has needed covenant waivers before, so the refinancing is a known question on the call.
findings.why_not_priced: The two 8-Ks were filed under item 7.01 with no press release and drew no wire coverage that I found. Paying down 2027 notes with cash from operations is evidence of positive Q3 free cash flow before the print. If the market had priced a done refinancing, the 2027 overhang and the bearish turn from Goldman, Mizuho and Jefferies on leverage and valuation would not be the visible narrative. Financing question answered: the money buys deleveraging, not a funding gap, so the sign is positive. It turns negative if the call says the RBL refinancing slips past Q4 or needs another waiver.
findings.independence: Sept 8 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1509991/000150999126000051/kos-20260908.htm). The Q2 release gives the RBL-refinancing and ~20% debt-reduction targets (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001509991/000150999126000046/kos_ex99x1-q2x2026.htm).

findings.finding: Winterfell-5 in the Gulf of America was temporarily abandoned in July 2026 after a production casing failure, the same failure mode as Winterfell-4 in 2025, and Winterfell-2 was shut in early Q2. Q3 GoA guidance is 13-15k boe/d against 14.3k in Q2, and the FY guide is 14-16k. Remediation cost, an impairment or a trimmed GoA outlook could be disclosed on the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Winterfell setbacks were disclosed in the Q3 2025 (-5.73%) and Q2 2026 (-5.95%) releases, both down days (baseline), but they were bundled with other items.
findings.why_not_priced: Known since Aug 3, and the Q3 guide was set knowing it, so this is mostly priced. What is not priced is the cost and any FY GoA guide trim. If an FY cut were expected, the FY 14-16k range would already sit below the 14.3k Q2 run-rate in the street models; it does not.
findings.independence: Third-party Q2 review noting the repeat casing failure (https://finsee.ai/earnings/kos/2026/q2/en/). Same Kosmos document as the bar.

findings.finding: Tullow (Jubilee operator, 28 Sep 2026) expects 14 Ghana cargoes in 2026 (11 Jubilee, 3 TEN), two more Jubilee cargoes than its November 2025 guidance, with eight in H2. It also recovered the remaining historic Ghana gas receivables by 28 Sep and raised FY FCF guidance to $170-250M. That points to Kosmos's FY Ghana guide of 12-13 net cargoes landing at the top, and to an easing of Ghana gas collection risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No KOS print with a cargo-guide raise in the baseline. The Q2 release kept cargo guidance unchanged and the stock fell 5.95%.
findings.why_not_priced: Tullow's cargo increase was first reported in August, so it is partly priced. The receivables recovery and the September completion of the campaign came after Kosmos last spoke (Aug 3). If priced, Kosmos's FY Ghana cargo guide would already be read at 13, not at the 12.5 midpoint.
findings.independence: Same Tullow document as the Jubilee production finding (shared source). Graphic Online 2026-07-14 on 99% uptime (https://www.graphic.com.gh/business/business-news/ghanas-oil-sector-rebounds-as-5-of-6-jubilee-wells-completed.html).

findings.finding: The sell side turned bearish in the week before the print: Jefferies cut KOS to Hold on 2026-10-28 'after stock soars 200% YTD', and MarketBeat put the consensus at 'Reduce' on 2026-10-23 (4 sell ratings among 9 firms). Earlier in 2026 Goldman went to Sell and Mizuho to Underperform. The stock is +11% over 20 days and -3% over 5.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 0 of 5 recent prints up (baseline). Valuation-based downgrades have preceded each sold print this year.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the downgrade landed two sessions before the window. It is filed because a Hold from a former Buy, two days before results, signals the bar for a positive reaction has risen. A contrarian reading (a bearish sell side makes a clean beat easier to buy) is possible, so the range straddles zero.
findings.independence: Goldman Sell / Mizuho Underperform via search snippet (https://seekingalpha.com/news/4573856-kosmos-energy-cut-to-sell-at-goldman-after-strong-2026-performance; page 403, headline only).

findings.finding: Short interest rose from 26.7M shares (2026-08-21) to 34.2M (2026-10-15 settlement), with days to cover at 2.93 against a 24-report average of 2.70. Shorts are building into the print, but the position is not crowded.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No squeeze reaction in the last five prints; all were down.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is public with a lag. At under 3 days to cover there is only a small squeeze mechanism if production and the refinancing land well. If shorts were crowded, DTC would be in the 5+ range, as in Sept 2025 (6.4).
findings.independence: Aggregator snippet of FINRA 2026-09-30 data: 33.9M shares, 2.4 DTC (search result).

findings.finding: The Jubilee gas price to Ghana National Gas Company was cut to $2.50/MMBtu from more than $3.08 under the revised terms, on about 115 MMscf/d gross. That trims Kosmos's Ghana gas revenue by roughly $2M a quarter, against total revenue of about $400M.
findings.why_not_priced: Immaterial and likely already in Q2 realisations ($6.81/Mcf blended gas price). Filed for completeness.
findings.independence: Same Graphic article as the Jubilee production finding (shared document, different line).

outside_window.finding: Jubilee 2027-28 drilling campaign of up to 10 wells (rig contract signed, rig arriving around mid-2027): long-dated production support, not a Q3 item.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive (top-of-guide production, late-quarter oil, deleveraging). That cuts against a reaction history of 0 of 5 prints up and a sell side that turned bearish this week, and it agrees with the +11% 20-day run-up, which suggests the good news is partly in the price. With skew null there is no option-market direction to beat.
lessons_applied: Lessons 1 and 6: the Jubilee production finding lands inside a guide set after the 94k figure was public, and this name has sold every print including a beat, so it went from +1.0 to +0.4
Lesson 5: the oil-price finding is a macro-to-company proxy, capped by hedges and unconfirmed cargo timing, so it went from +0.8 to +0.5
Lesson 2: the unrealised hedge MTM is a below-the-line one-off with no path to guidance, so it went from -0.4 to -0.2

Lesson 4: financing was signed after asking what the money buys (note paydown from operating cash, RBL refinancing to remove the 2027 overhang), so it stays positive, trimmed from +0.6 to +0.5 for the history of covenant waivers
Lesson 6: Winterfell and the Tullow cargo read-through are both partly inside the guide set on Aug 3, so they moved from -0.5 to -0.3 and from +0.4 to +0.3

Lesson 7: the sell-side turn is pre-window positioning and partly priced, so it went from -0.3 to -0.2; short interest was checked and is not crowded (2.9 DTC), so the small positive squeeze term stands
Lesson 1 on the scaled number: the reaction function moved p_up from 52 to 46 and abs_move from 7.5 to 7.0; print_vs_bar went from +4 to +3 because the street bar is soft (Barchart says no consensus)
